name: Moonfall
summary: The Crooked Moon will fall in thirteen nights. Eight ancient powers pull it down; each kill buys a day. At the end, Kehlenn makes her last offer.

closes.when: flag.moonfall_started and flag.moonfall_nights_left <= 0 and not flag.moonfall_fled
closes.warn: The moon is almost on top of us.

stages.journal: The moon shrieked in Kehlenn's voice: it will fall in thirteen nights. The Vagrant waits at the Round with his train.
stages.hint: Speak to the Vagrant in Wickermoor.

stages.journal: We took up the hunt. Eight Old Fears pull the moon down, and each one we kill buys a day.
stages.hint: Find the next Old Fear: the Round's map and the roads show where.

stages.journal: All eight are dead. The moon hangs a few hundred feet over the hill, and Kehlenn has one last offer.
stages.hint: Climb the hill and answer Kehlenn.

stages.journal: We refused Kehlenn's offer. The moon rose back into the sky, and its face faded.
We accepted Kehlenn's offer. The moon fell on everyone else, and we floated in a green sea to remake the realm.
We took the Vagrant's train out on the last night, and left the Hollow to the moon.
The nights ran out. The moon fell on the Hollow, and there was no one left to see it.
